Description
This is Volume 11 of the classic manga series 功夫旋風兒 (Kung Fu Boy), written and illustrated by Tatsuya Egawa (蛭田達也).
Published by Tong Li Comics, this edition is the officially licensed Traditional Chinese version released in Taiwan.
It features the iconic artwork and energetic style that made the series a beloved martial arts comedy.
